data.title: SIM Swap Indicator Chain
data.description: Detects the full SIM swap attack chain: phone number change followed by password reset followed by high-value account action in rapid sequence. This multi-stage correlation captures the complete attack lifecycle where the attacker first takes over the phone number, then uses it to reset the account password via SMS OTP, and finally executes a high-value transfer or account modification.

detection.condition: stage1_sim_change | followed_by stage2_password_reset | followed_by stage3_high_value_action on user_id within 24h

falsepositives: Legitimate users who change carriers, reset a forgotten password, and then make a large purchase in the same day
